[package]
name = "tapestry-core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.75"
description = "Tapestry programme contracts: identity, session, artefact, review, telemetry and TAP/1 protocol schemas"
license = "MIT"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
sha2 = "0.10"
hex = "0.4"
chrono = { version = "0.4", features = ["serde"] }
semver = { version = "1", features = ["serde"] }

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[profile.release]

strip = true

# tapestry-core

Shared contracts for the Tapestry programme: the versioned schemas and
protocol types every Tapestry client consumes. No client may independently
redefine core wire types.

**Status: Gate 0 (Foundations).** This crate is contracts only — no I/O, no
async runtime, no provider calls. Transport behaviour (framing on the wire,
crypto, reconnect) belongs to later gates and to the transport swarm.

## Module map

| Module | Contents |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Typed, time-sortable identifiers (`SessionId`, `ArtifactId`, `DeviceId`, `ReviewId`) |
| `identity` | `DeviceIdentity` and `CapabilitySet` advertised during discovery |
| `session` | `Session`, `SessionState`, legal state transitions, `SessionEvent` |
| `artifact` | The `Artifact` envelope and `ArtifactKind`; content-addressed digests |
| `review` | `ReviewDecision` and `ReviewRecord` — human judgement as first-class data |
| `telemetry` | Correlation hierarchy and timing-event names |
| `capability` | Codec descriptors and H.265/H.264 negotiation (probe-first, never assumed) |
| `protocol` | TAP/1: frame schema, channels, resumable chunks, capability negotiation |

## Design rules

- Every public type is a serde data contract; wire formats evolve only
  through a versioned, compatibility-checked change.
- Artefact identity is stable across transport: identity lives in the
  envelope, never in a transport address.
- Codec selection requires explicit capability probing; H.265 is never
  assumed from platform identity.
- Idempotency keys and monotonic sequence numbers are mandatory in the
  protocol types so repeated events cannot create duplicate effects.

## Development

```sh
cargo test
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
deliver --spec deliver.toml
```

Version transitions are owned by kaptaind; do not bump `VERSION` manually.

# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest supported release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the project maintainers. Do not open a public issue containing exploit details, credentials, or personal data. Include affected versions, reproduction steps, and potential impact. The maintainers will acknowledge the report and coordinate remediation and disclosure.

[[file]]
path = "src/lib.rs"
required = true
forbid_regex = ["TOD[O]", "FIX[M]E", "unimplemented!"]

[[file]]
path = "README.md"
required = true
min_size_bytes = 800
require_regex = ["tapestry-core", "Gate 0", "cargo test"]

[[file]]
path = "VERSION"
required = true

[[command]]
name = "cargo test"
cmd = ["cargo", "test"]
expect_exit = 0
timeout_secs = 300
stdout_contains = ["test result: ok"]

[[command]]
name = "cargo clippy"
cmd = ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets", "--", "-D", "warnings"]
expect_exit = 0
timeout_secs = 300

[[command]]
name = "cargo fmt"
cmd = ["cargo", "fmt", "--check"]
expect_exit = 0
timeout_secs = 60

# kaptaind configuration — version authority for tapestry-core

[watch]
path = "."
recursive = true
ignore_file = ".kaptainignore"

[cluster]
window = 5

[weights]
s = 0.35
a = 0.30
d = 0.20
r = 0.15

[version_thresholds]
minor = 0.6
patch = 0.1

[push]
enabled = false
branch = "main"

[ratelimit]
min_commit_interval = 10

[test]
command = "cargo test"
required = true

[project]
name = "tapestry-core"

[tools]
claude = true
codex = true

lwoodz = true
traci = true

[rules]
documentation = true
security = true
testing = true
